description:
It aims to manipulate deposit and praise gadgets for customers interacting with AAVE's lending pool. As the user is rewarded for their investment through Aave's lending protocol and other lending protocols, user is mostly aligned to use this ecosystem to handle his investments. It facilitates user deposits, tracks deposit periods, and allows users to claim  rewards based on their deposited amounts and specified percentages which can be fixed or variable on the wish of investor. This integrates the idea of investing and the habit of regular depositing, which leverages the user's financial discipline.

We all know bull run, is at the horizon. So, invest now, sit back and relax to receive compounded yield rewards in fiat.

how_its_made: We faced difficulty sending the investing deposits in the AAVE lending protocol, where the user sents the deposits regularly to AAVE to invest it and benefit from it after the buffer period. We were able to fix this by obtaining an optimistic logic which fulfilled our requirements.
